v2.7.6:
App data is stored under the 5ghost_wifi_lab folder on the SD card. Existing files from the previous 5ghost folder are moved on launch. The About page links to the public GitHub repository.

v2.7.5:
Guided Audit on the main menu. Disable Expansion before opening USART so Scan does not false-report wiring. Home menu wrap. Back from About stays on About.

v2.7.4:
Guided Audit chooses handshake or clientless PMKID from PMF and whether stations are present.

v2.7.3:
Passive scan covers 2.4 GHz channels 1-13 and 5 GHz 20 MHz channels, including DFS receive-only.

v2.7.1:
Select multiple access points from the scan list in one run. Same-SSID mesh nodes are targeted together.

v2.7.0:
BLE recon, iBeacon, GATT, and BadBLE HID on the companion module, plus dual-band Wi-Fi tools.
